text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
No matter the race, our aim is always to
win, no?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
But in reality... Victory alone is not
enough.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
It is my familial duty to not just win, but
win in an
elegant and magnificent
fashion.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, even at the Tenno Sho, I plan
to show
the crowd exactly how a Mejiro
runs.
